## MGIT EEE Students Secure First Prize at CSI AI 100K Project Expo

News Date : 14 Mar 2026News ReportStudents from the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) achieved a significant milestone by securing theFirst Prizeat theCSI AI 100K Project Expo. The event witnessed participation from more than90 projects from various institutions, making the competition highly competitive.The winning project, titled“Smart UPS Monitoring System,”earned the team acash prize of ₹15,000. The project focuses on ensuring continuous and reliable power supply, which is particularly critical in healthcare environments where power interruptions can directly affect patient care.The project was developed by the following students of the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering:G. SrigneshA. AnushaS. SivaniP. ChakanyaThe management and faculty of MGIT congratulated the students for their outstanding achievement and appreciated their innovative approach to solving real-world challenges.

Students from the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT) achieved a significant milestone by securing theFirst Prizeat theCSI AI 100K Project Expo. The event witnessed participation from more than90 projects from various institutions, making the competition highly competitive.
The winning project, titled“Smart UPS Monitoring System,”earned the team acash prize of ₹15,000. The project focuses on ensuring continuous and reliable power supply, which is particularly critical in healthcare environments where power interruptions can directly affect patient care.
The project was developed by the following students of the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering:
- G. Srignesh
- A. Anusha
- S. Sivani
- P. Chakanya
The management and faculty of MGIT congratulated the students for their outstanding achievement and appreciated their innovative approach to solving real-world challenges.
